Message.Name: Accrued Interest Message
Message.Description: This message informs about the accrued interest for bonds and mortgage- backed bonds

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: NumberDays
Field.Description: Number of days for which accrued interest is provided

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: AccruedInterestScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all accrued interests

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: AccruedInterestGroup
Field.Description: Group repeated 31 times, the combination Date / Accrued Interest

Message.Name: Interest For Settlement Day Message
Message.Description: This message informs about the interest for settlement day for bonds and mortgage-backed bonds

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Stock Exchange date (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: SettlementDate
Field.Description: Settlement date (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: Interest
Field.Description: Interest for the settlement day defined by field "SettlementDate". Provided with 0 if settlement date is not significant

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Code of the currency in which the interest is determined

Field.Name: InterestScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to the interest for the settlement day

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Group.Name: AccruedInterestGroup
Group.Description: Group repeated 31 times, the combination Date / Accrued Interest

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Date of accrued interest (YYYYMMDD)

Field.Name: AccruedInterest
Field.Description: Accrued interest for the day defined by field date
